name: Choksi Asia Limited
about: Choksi Asia Limited primarily engages in the manufacture and sale of photosensitized materials and other products for the healthcare industry in India. It sells X-Ray films, lead screens, chemicals, radiation shielding materials, X-Ray generator, radiography camera, radioactive Sources and trading of other related accessories. The company also provides X-ray films and chemicals, which include laser green, laser blue, and laser chemical products; X-ray accessories, comprising screens, cassettes, illuminators, and aprons; and laser NDT chemicals for processing industrial X-ray film. In addition, it trades in specialty x-ray films and medical equipment. The company was formerly known as Choksi Imaging Limited and changed its name to Choksi Asia Limited in April 2025. Choksi Asia Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India.
